 SC Rio Tinto-FC Porto tickets: on sale Saturday at 13:30, €2.50 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article The Rio Tinto Sports Complex hosts the match between SC Rio Tinto and FC Porto this Saturday at 3:00 pm, in the third round of the Women's Portuguese Cup.
 Priced at €2.50 each, tickets will be available at the venue's ticket office from 1:30 pm on matchday. Gates will open at the same time.
